αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun of a thing, unemphatic ’it’ (masc. χιτών), as direct object of a verb: ἐθηήσαντο αὐτὸν ’gazed at it’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’ · also ὁ αὐτός ’the same’, fem. gen. sg. with the article: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’ · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun, of a woman speaking: ἐξ ἐμεῦ … αὐτῆς ’from me myself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a chair), after ἐκ: ἐξ αὐτῆς ’out of it’
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’) · also ’without more, empty-handed’, of sending away with no gift (αὔτως ἀππέμψει ’will send us off with nothing’) · also ’to no purpose, idly’, of testing: αὔτως … πειρητίζων ’testing (each man) to no purpose’ · also ’merely, only’, qualifying a kind (ἦ αὔτως οἷοί τε … κύνες ’or merely such as … dogs’) · also ’idly, as he is’, of lying (ἦ αὔτως κεῖται ’or does he lie there idle’)
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βέλος: βέλος — missile, thing thrown; neut. acc. sg. (here a hurled rock) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’missile’ (βέλος Ἀντινόοιο ’the missile of Antinous’)
βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of μνησαμένοις: ’of the might’ (Κύκλωπός τε βίης ’the Cyclops’ might’) · also periphrastic gen. with a proper adj.: ’the force of Iphicles’ (βίης Ἰφικληείης, a periphrasis for his name) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἔμπαιος ‘skilled’: ‘in strength’ (ἔμπαιον … βίης ‘skilled in strength’)
βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. with εἴκων, the thing yielded to: ’yielding to force’ (βίῃ καὶ κάρτεϊ εἴκων) · also dat. of respect, ’in strength’ (βίῃ φέρτερος ’stronger in strength’)
βουκόλος: βουκόλος — cowherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν): ’went’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γήμαιθ: γαμέω — marry (of a woman, mid. γαμέομαι); aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (γήμαιθ’ = γήμαιτο), potential with κε: ’she might marry’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γνοίης: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential after κε: ’you would come to know’
γῆμαι: γαμέω — marry, take as wife (of a man); aor. inf. act.: ’to marry’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also stool, seat (of the carver’s seat) · also δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. acc. sg. (δίφρον καταθεὶς ’setting down a stool’)
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeking’
διοϊστεύσειν: διοϊστεύω — shoot an arrow through; fut. inf. act.: ’to shoot through’
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
δύναμις: δύναμις — power, ability, strength; fem. nom. sg.
δύνασαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δύνασαι/δύνῃ): ’you can, you are able’
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic form (unaccented after an accented word): ’I am’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εὐπείθεος: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. gen. sg.
εὐρύμαχος: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. nom. sg.
εὔμαιος: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέτ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (θέτ’ = θέτο), in tmesis (περὶ … θέτ’ = περιέθετο): ’set about’
θέτο: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’set (for himself)’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτο = ἀπέθετο): ’put off, laid aside’ · also with a name as object: ’gave, bestowed (a name)’ (τὸ γὰρ θέτο … μήτηρ ’his mother gave him that’)
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. nom. sg.
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’ · also nom. sg. in apposition to a name following: θεὸς … Ἑρμείας ’a god, Hermes’
θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θυρέων: θύρη — door; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic θυρῶν)
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. · also ’make (someone a certain way)’, with double acc.: ’made him (taller)’
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if you should wish’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλῃσθα)
κάλ: καλός — fair, beautiful, goodly; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with ἱερά · also adverbial neut. acc. pl., elided: ’well, finely’ (κάλ’ ἔβαλες ’you struck well’)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’) · also + impf. indic., unreal past: ‘would have been’ (καί κέ τοι … ἀμφεπονεῖτο ‘would have been busy for you’) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ‘from where you would’ (ὅθεν κέ τοι … ἄλφοι)
κακός: κακός — bad, base, poor; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’bad, poor’
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’a fine thing (to hear)’
καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’) · also + acc., of place, ’along’ (κατ’ ἠερόεντα κέλευθα ’along the misty paths’) · also + acc., ‘over against’ (κατ’ ἄντηστιν ‘right opposite’)
κατόπισθε: κατόπισθε(ν) — behind, after; adv., or prep. + gen.: ’behind’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν)
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κορώνῃ: κορώνη — handle, curved door-ring; fem. dat. sg.
κραδίη: κραδίη — heart; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg. (same form): ’heart!’ (τέτλαθι δή, κραδίη ’endure now, heart’)
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κῶας: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. acc. sg. (Attic κῴδιον)
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μίαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; numeral, fem. acc. sg.
μακρήν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. sg.
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μελάνθιος: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. nom. sg. (beside the by-form Μελανθεύς)
μελαίνης: μέλας, μέλαινα — black, dark; fem. gen. sg.
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be furious, rage; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
μενοινᾷ: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; pres. 3 sg.
μετέειφ: μετεῖπον (μετά + εἶπον) — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (μετέειφ’ = μετέειπε)
μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’)
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνάσθω: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him woo’
μνηστήρεσσιν: μνηστήρ — suitor; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυθησαίμην: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, recount; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I could tell’
μυκήνης: Μυκήνη — Mycenae, Agamemnon’s city; fem. gen. sg.
μόρσιμος: μόρσιμος — destined, fated; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’the destined (suitor)’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’)
μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ‘young men!’ (νέοι, ἐκπέμψασθε ‘young men, send out’)
νεμεσσῶμαι: νεμεσσάομαι — be indignant at, disapprove of; pres. 1 sg. mid., contracted, epic doubled σ (= Attic νεμεσῶμαι), + dat. · also + acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’resent (you) for …’ (οὔ σε νεμεσσῶμαι κεχολῶσθαι)
νευρὴν: νευρή — bowstring, cord; fem. acc. sg.
νεώτερός: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος ’younger’; masc. nom. sg.
νοσφισσαμένη: νοσφίζομαι — turn away from, abandon; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having left’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’ · also agreeing with a named dative: ’to Tiresias alone’ (Τειρεσίῃ … οἴῳ), ’he alone’ (τῷ … οἴῳ) · also agreeing with τοι ’you’: ’you alone’ (τοι οἴῳ)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, + τε: ’such as, like’ (οἷόν τε κρομύοιο λοπὸν κάτα ’such as is along the skin of an onion’)
οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’ · also οἷός τε + inf., ’able to, fit to’ (οἷός τε … κήδεσθαι ’such as to care for, able to care for’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
πάτερ: πατήρ — father; voc. sg. · also πατέρα, masc. acc. sg., elided (πάτερ’ = πατέρα): ’father’ (μητρὸς … πάτερ’ ’mother’s father’)
πέποιθα: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 1 sg.
παράκοιτιν: παράκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’) · also + acc., ’beside, contrary to’ (παρὰ μοῖραν ’beside what is fitting’)
πειρήσεται: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; fut. mid. 3 sg.
πελέκεας: πέλεκυς — axe; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εας (= Attic πελέκεις)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
πηνελόπειαν: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; acc. sg.
πινυτή: πινυτός — discerning, prudent; fem. nom. sg.
πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος, neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’most, the greatest amount’
ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτιδέγμενοι: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’what a (word)’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
πόροι: πόρον (πορεῖν) — give, furnish; aor. opt. 3 sg. (a defective aorist with no present in this sense)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’) · also a preposition + gen., ’from (the side of)’ (πὰρ Ταφίων ’from the Taphians’) · also a preposition + dat., ’among, in the company of’ (πὰρ παύροισι ’among few’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
στάθμην: στάθμη — carpenter’s line or rule, for marking a straight edge; fem. acc. sg.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
στῆσε: ἵστημι — set up, station, moor; aor. act. 3 sg., transitive (contrast intransitive ἕστασαν)
στῆσεν: ἵστημι — set, make stand; aor. 3 sg., transitive, unaugmented (= ἔστησε): ’stopped, set down’
σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also with a noun, neut. acc. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε δώμαθ’ ’this house’, plural for one dwelling)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέρπομαι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. pres. 1 sg.: ’I delight (my heart)’
τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει)
τανύσσαι: τανύω — stretch; aor. inf., epic σσ, used for an imperative: ’stretch!’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθνάμεν: θνῄσκω — die; perf. inf. ’to be dead’, epic -μεν (= Attic τεθνάναι)
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself) · also gen. governed by μεσσηγύς ’between’ (νηός τε καὶ αὐτοῦ Τηλεμάχοιο ’the ship and Telemachus himself’) · also plain possessive gen. with a noun: ’Telemachus’ (table)’ (Τηλεμάχοιο τράπεζαν) · also objective gen., dependent on φόνος: ’the slaying of Telemachus’
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι) · also τοι, the affirming particle, accented τοί before an enclitic: ἀλλ’ ἦ τοί σε ’but truly you’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’) · also demonstrative dat. pl. of things just named, ‘with these’ (τοῖς ἔξειμι ‘with these I shall go out’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’ · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl. ’on which’ (κώεα, τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν ’the fleeces on which he had slept’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’)
τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg., subject of its clause: ’which’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. acc. sg., object of its clause (τὸ πρὶν μέν ῥ’ ἐφόρει ’which he used to carry before’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον · also nom. dual with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … θεράποντε)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’) · also adverbial, with κε: ’in that case, otherwise’ (τῷ κέ μιν … παύσαμεν ’otherwise we should have stopped him’)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρτερόν: φέρτερος — better, stronger; comparative (suppletive to ἀγαθός); neut. nom. sg., predicate
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’ · also φαίνω, mid. pres. 3 sg., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears, shows itself’
φοινικόεσσαν: φοινικόεις — crimson, purple-red; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic φοινικοῦς)
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
χαλεπήνῃ: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, angry, deal harshly; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fear with μή: ’lest he be harsh’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general temporal clause with ὅτε: ’whenever (he) turns harsh’
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
χώρου: χῶρος — place, spot, land; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄιδρις: ’of the place’
ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath, soul; fem. gen. sg. (περὶ ψυχῆς ’for one’s life’)
ἀέθλια: ἀέθλιον — prize, contest (epic; cf. Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), in apposition to the subject: ἀέθλια τοῖο ἄνακτος ’prizes of that lord’
ἀγάγοι: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he lead’
ἀγαυοί: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
ἀλοιφῇ: ἀλοιφή — ointment, anything smeared on (fat, oil); fem. dat. sg., instrumental
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνέγνω: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know for certain, recognise; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-γνω), gnomic
ἀνέκαιε: ἀνακαίω — kindle, light up; impf. 3 sg., augmented after the preverb
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀνίστατο: ἀνίστημι — set up, raise; mid. rise, get up; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was rising, got up’
ἀναΐξας: ἀναΐσσω — start up suddenly, spring up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίνοος: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπαμύνασθαι: ἀπαμύνω — ward off; mid. defend oneself against, keep off; aor. inf. mid.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, troublesome; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate governing an inf. · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’grievous, hard’ (δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε, of λαῖτμα) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative in a double acc.: ’hard’ (τὸν … ἀργαλέον θήσει ’will make it hard’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν: ’grievous’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν … δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε)
ἀρετῇ: ἀρετή — excellence, virtue, prowess; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in excellence’
ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
ἀχνυμένῳ: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’grieved (though I was)’
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγεθ: ἄγετε (elided ἄγεθ’) — come now! (interjectional imperative of ἄγω); 2 pl.
ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), subject: τόδε φαίνετ’ ἄεθλον ’this contest appears’
ἄκικυς: ἄκικυς — feeble, powerless; masc. nom. sg., of uncertain origin
ἄλλην: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’ · also in apposition to a plural subject: ’both of us’ (ἱκόμεθ’ ἄμφω)
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’ · also the shortened ἄρ before a consonant, without elision: ’then’ (ἐπεὶ ἄρ βλέφαρ’ … ἀμφικαλύψῃ ’when then (sleep) has covered the eyelids’)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄφρονι: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. dat. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐέδνοισιν: ἕεδνον — bridal gift; neut. dat. pl. ἕεδνα, epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’with bridal gifts’
ἐέλδωρ: ἐέλδωρ — wish, desire; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’bore’
ἐδύναντο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they could’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + inf.
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg.
ἐνένιπεν: ἐνίπτω (aor. ἐνένιπον) — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’rebuked’
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐντανύσαι: ἐντανύω — stretch, string (a bow); aor. inf. act. (= Attic ἐντεῖναι)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’) · also + gen., of place: ’at, on’ (ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῆς ’at the edge’)
ἐπεύχετο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐπιήνδανε: ἐπιανδάνω — please, be agreeable to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (ἀνδάνω, augmented ἥνδανε)
ἐπιβουκόλος: ἐπιβουκόλος — one set over the cattle, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
ἐφώνησεν: φωνέω — utter, speak, give voice to; aor. 3 sg.
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’) · also prep. + gen. with a particle between it and its noun: ἔκ γε γυναικός ’at the hands of a woman’
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’whatever he might come in need of’ (ὅτευ κεχρημένος ἔλθοι)
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνεικε: φέρω (suppletive aor. stem ἐνεκ-) — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg.; whether this form has lost an augment is uncertain: ’brought’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’) · also relative, ’from which, whence’ (ἔνθεν ἔπινον ’from which they drank’)
ἔξοχ: ἔξοχα — exceedingly, surpassingly; adv., elided (ἔξοχ’ = ἔξοχα)
ἔπεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle form
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔσχεθεν: ἔχω — have, hold, restrain; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form ending -θε(ν): ’restrained, checked’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ‘he came’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἰδόντας: ὁράω — see; aor. part. masc. acc. pl. (stem ἰδ-): ’those who saw’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱερὴ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. nom. sg.
ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
ἲς: ἴς (gen. ἰνός) — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg., in the periphrasis ἱερὴ ἲς + gen. ’the sacred strength of ...’, i.e. the hero himself · also plain ’force, might’ of a thing: ἲς ἀνέμοιο ’the force of the wind’
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. after πρίν γε, ’until’: ’until she has seen (me)’ (πρίν γ’ αὐτόν με ἴδηται)
ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε) · also ὀνομάζω (simple, no preverb) — name, call by name, tell the name of; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’name (him)!’ (τρίτον ἄνδρ’ ὀνόμαζε)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’) · also ’how’ + aor. indic., indirect question after a verb of telling (κατάλεξον ὅπως ἤντησας ’tell how you came upon’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι) · also causal + indic.: ’since, because’ (ὅτ’ οὐκ ἐθέλουσι δικαίως ’since they are not willing to act justly’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑμέας: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; acc. pl., epic ὑμέας (= Attic ὑμᾶς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὤμοιϊν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual (epic ὤμοιϊν = Attic ὤμοιν), taken as a gen. of separation with ἀπό carried over: ‘from the two shoulders’; the dual and the case are the usual reading, not certain
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥυτῆρα: ῥυτήρ — protector, guardian (from ῥύομαι); masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’as protector’
